evals.prompt: We are launching an AI essay-review feature in our test-prep app. Define the metric set we should track to know if it works.
evals.expected_output: A layered metric set: one leading North Star behavior, a lagging impact metric read via holdout, one primary per initiative, and explicit guardrails/counter-metrics.
expectations: Distinguishes leading (behavioral, short window) from lagging (impact, quarterly) metrics
Defines exactly one primary metric for the initiative
Includes at least one counter-metric or guardrail chosen before launch
States the denominator for the key metrics

evals.prompt: Our conversion to paid jumped 15% after we hardened the paywall. Ship it everywhere?
evals.expected_output: A response that checks quality of conversion before celebrating, especially first-conversion churn/refunds, and warns about short-term optimization damaging long-term trust.
expectations: Asks for first-conversion churn or refund rate as a counter-metric
Warns that a confused and a converted user can look identical short-term
Does not recommend shipping on the primary metric alone

evals.prompt: The CEO wants DAU as our main KPI. We are an exam-prep product where students leave after passing. What do I say?
evals.expected_output: A response that explains why DAU misfits deadline-driven usage, proposes cycle-appropriate metrics, and reframes post-exam churn as graduation.
expectations: Explains the mismatch between DAU and deadline-driven product cycles
Treats churn after goal achievement as graduation, suggesting cohorting by exam date
